name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: SMB Digital Success Lead | AI Agent Building, Scaled Onboarding & Retention
summary: Customer success and onboarding leader who builds the AI and automation behind a scaled success model, not just uses it. At Solenzo, I design, tune, and run AI agents and 20+ production workflows that score customer signals, trigger outreach, recover no-shows, and reactivate accounts, with rubric-based evaluation and human review on the output. Before that, I onboarded 25+ SMB customers a month at Wix while leading a team of 20 (later 8), and retained all but one of 15-20 channel partners at Birdeye. I know what to automate and what needs a person.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Build, tune, and run AI agents that score each business's signals and generate personalized outreach, breaking manual workflows into agent architectures with custom logic.
Design evaluation loops and rubric-based grading for AI output, and personally review and label data so agents stay accurate before anything reaches a customer.

Architected a 20+ workflow lifecycle system in GoHighLevel covering intake, routing, onboarding nurture, reminders, no-show recovery, and reactivation, integrated through webhooks and Zapier, Make, and n8n.
Translate non-technical stakeholders' goals into precise agent requirements and prompts, then prototype, deploy, and drive adoption.
Own client relationships end to end and expand retainer scope by identifying complementary services.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed multi-stakeholder accounts, resolving feedback promptly to protect satisfaction and retention, and presented performance data in QBRs.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners serving SMBs across health, home services, and retail, retaining all but one (~94%).
Built automated product-training and communication sequences that reduced onboarding friction and scaled enablement across the network.
Analyzed utilization data to catch adoption gaps early and recommend interventions that reduced churn; fed prioritized feedback to Product and Engineering.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Rebuilt internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors, and served a banking-industry client.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ SMB customers per month, holding 110% of implementation targets and 120% of sales targets.
Led a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8) on a new vertical that went from proof of concept to profitable, building the process, training, and CRM data standards it ran on.
Managed a high-value SMB portfolio, contributing to a 25% conversion improvement and 30% traffic growth across the e-commerce segment.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Sold and scoped CRM and professional-services automation (including time tracking and billing) to agencies and firms; ranked top three on a team of 8 to 15.
